apparatusParameters.label: Box width along the light/dark axis
Light compartment share of the width

sessionParameters.label: Longest gap between samples that still counts as tracked

zones.geometry: 0 <= x < box_width_cm x light_fraction, within the box.
box_width_cm x light_fraction <= x <= box_width_cm; the dividing line belongs to the dark side.

events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in light.
Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in dark.
Later sample time of a counted interval entering light.
Later sample time of a counted interval entering dark.

metrics.label: Analyzed duration
metrics.definition: Samples are box-local centimeters with the origin at the light-side corner; samples outside the box count as lost. A counted interval is a pair of consecutive tracked samples with 0 < dt <= max_sample_gap_s.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in light
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in the light compartment.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in dark
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in the dark compartment.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Light time ratio
metrics.definition: Share of analyzed duration in the light compartment.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Light entries
metrics.definition: Counted intervals from dark to light.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Transitions
metrics.definition: Counted intervals whose samples are in different compartments.
metrics.formula: count(light to dark) + count(dark to light)
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Latency to dark
metrics.definition: Time of the first tracked sample inside the zone, from the trial start. The zone is dark.
metrics.formula: first tracked sample time in dark
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) when no tracked sample is inside the zone; missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) without counted intervals.
